legal.title: Privacy Notice
legal.intro: Trust grows from clarity. This notice explains what information this website may handle and what you can expect from The Hair Narrative.

sections.title: A note before we begin
paragraphs: I believe healthy relationships begin when both sides understand the path ahead. If you have questions about this notice or about the way your information is handled, I will be happy to answer them.
Thank you for being here.

— Nina
Founder of The Hair Narrative

sections.title: The website today
paragraphs: The Hair Narrative is currently a static editorial website. It does not create user accounts, accept payments, confirm bookings, process newsletter subscriptions or collect information through website forms.

Contact links on the site open your own email application. If you choose to write, your message is sent through the email services used by you and The Hair Narrative; it is not stored in a website-managed database.

sections.title: Information you may choose to share
paragraphs: When you contact The Hair Narrative by email, you may choose to provide:
Please do not send sensitive personal information unless it is genuinely necessary for your request.
bullets: The information included in your message.
For a bridal inquiry, details such as your country, event date and event location.
For an educational inquiry, information about what you would like to learn or discuss.

sections.title: Essential technical information
paragraphs: The hosting and security services required to deliver this website may automatically process limited technical information, such as an IP address, browser or device type, request time and the pages requested.
This information is used only to deliver, maintain and protect the website. The current site does not use analytics, advertising or behavioral-tracking tools.

sections.title: How information is used
paragraphs: Information you send is used only to:
Writing to ask about The Letter expresses your interest, but it does not complete an automated newsletter subscription. No automated mailing list is active through this website.
bullets: Read and respond to your message.
Understand and follow up on your inquiry.
Provide information you have requested about bridal or educational services.
Comply with applicable legal or administrative obligations.

sections.title: Sharing information
paragraphs: The Hair Narrative does not sell or rent personal information.

Information may be handled only by service providers that are necessary to operate website hosting, security or email communication, or when disclosure is required by applicable law. These providers process information according to their own services and privacy terms.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: Email conversations are kept only for as long as reasonably necessary to respond, maintain an active relationship, document a service inquiry or meet applicable obligations.
Essential technical logs, when generated by hosting or security providers, are retained according to those providers’ operational schedules.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law, you may ask to access, correct, update or delete personal information shared with The Hair Narrative, or object to its continued use.
To make a request, write to hello@thehairnarrative.com and describe what you need. Reasonable verification may be requested before acting on a request.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Reasonable care is taken when handling information. However, no email or internet transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Please consider this before including confidential information in a message.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
paragraphs: This notice will be updated if the website begins using forms, subscriptions, payments, analytics or other tools that change how personal information is handled. The current version and its update date will remain available on this page.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about privacy may be sent to: hello@thehairnarrative.com

legal.review: Preliminary editorial copy. Professional legal review is required before publication.
